case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms. Fuchsreiter,

You wrote that your price is clear and that we should ask if anything is not. One thing is not clear to us: how it fits the offers we hold for the pump shaft for our new HX series.

On the competing offers:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).
Another supplier has offered EUR 36.00 for this part (offer:70210-0).

On your side of the table:
Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH looks for new customers (news:20260309-03).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 27.97; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.12; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your shop a clear order for a part in a new series, and with the competing offers above it is the version we can take forward. Option B is a genuine alternative if a longer payment term suits you better.

Please send us your reply on Option A so that we can compare it properly with the others. Before the sign-off, one honest question: what would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hallo, I looked at your numbers on the material and the other quote, and you make a fair point. We did not know that - a fair point. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. With the 14 days payment and 35 days lead time you offered, I can come down to €30.50 per unit. So our current Angebot is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. 

Let me know if this works so we can get the machines running.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

For whoever has to approve this on your side: Option A gives Zerspanung Dralveck a firm unit price, quick payment on every invoice and a lead time you already know from your own offer. It is straightforward to accept as it stands, and it gives your machines work on a new series.
